With a bound terminal, right-click any ground to plant a Quantum Node.

Each node bridges into the anchored controller's grid through a virtual connection, so adjacent AE2 devices join the network directly — §avanilla cable distance limits simply do not apply§r. Each connection carries dense-cable capacity: §b32 channels§r, and the node itself consumes none. Idle draw is §e10 AE/t§r by default.

Nodes work within the same dimension only. Shift+right-click a node with the terminal to destroy it.
